tools.name: search_usgs_earthquakes
tools.description: Query the anonymous USGS FDSN Event service and return a bounded, provenance-hashed earthquake catalog plus canonical GeoJSON and table projections.

startTime.description: Inclusive UTC start with an explicit timezone.

endTime.description: Inclusive UTC end with an explicit timezone; at most 366 days after start.

offset.description: USGS one-based result offset for bounded pagination.

tools.name: analyze_usgs_gutenberg_richter
tools.description: Estimate a publication-auditable Gutenberg–Richter b-value from one complete, provenance-hashed USGS catalog using an explicit magnitude-completeness threshold, explicit magnitude type, deterministic bins, and the Aki maximum-likelihood estimator with discrete-bin correction.

completenessMagnitude.description: Researcher-supplied Mc; this tool does not estimate completeness.

binWidth.description: Magnitude discretization ΔM. Mc and included magnitudes must align to this grid.

magnitudeType.description: Exact single USGS preferred magnitude type, for example mw or ml; cross-scale conversion is denied.

tools.name: analyze_usgs_omori_utsu
tools.description: Fit a bounded Omori–Utsu non-homogeneous Poisson aftershock-decay model to one complete provenance-hashed USGS catalog with explicit mainshock, observation, time-completeness, magnitude-completeness, magnitude-type, bin, and parameter boundaries; returns fit status, audit and publication tables, decay/residual Vega-Lite, and deterministic receipts.

mainshockTime.description: Researcher-supplied mainshock origin instant; must precede the observation window.

observationStartTime.description: Inclusive observation start contained in the catalog query.

observationEndTime.description: Inclusive observation end contained in the catalog query.

completenessStartTime.description: Researcher-supplied time after which the catalog is considered complete; fit starts here.

magnitudeType.description: One exact USGS preferred magnitude type; no scale conversion.

rateBinWidthSeconds.description: Fixed time-bin width; must produce 4–500 bins after the time-completeness boundary.

tools.name: get_usgs_event_detail
tools.description: Fetch one USGS ComCat event by exact event id, including preferred-origin quality and uncertainty fields plus a bounded product inventory and renderer-ready projections.

eventId.description: Exact USGS/ComCat event identifier from a catalog result.

tools.name: fetch_noaa_coops_water_levels
tools.description: Fetch exact observed water levels from the official NOAA CO-OPS production API and return UTC-, datum-, unit-, and station-normalized table, GeoJSON, Vega-Lite, content, and network receipts.

stationId.description: Exact seven-digit NOAA CO-OPS station identifier.

startTime.description: Inclusive instant with an explicit timezone and exact minute precision.

endTime.description: Inclusive instant with an explicit timezone and exact minute precision; no more than 31 days after start.

datum.description: Explicit NOAA vertical datum; never inferred.

tools.name: normalize_usgs_earthquake_geojson
tools.description: Normalize a user-supplied USGS GeoJSON FeatureCollection offline with the same scientific and size contract as a live query.

tools.name: normalize_usgs_event_detail_geojson
tools.description: Normalize a user-downloaded USGS event detail Feature offline, preserving preferred-origin uncertainty and a bounded product/content manifest without fetching linked files.

tools.name: normalize_noaa_coops_water_level_json
tools.description: Normalize a user-downloaded NOAA CO-OPS water-level JSON response offline with the same UTC, station, coordinate, datum, unit, row, and renderer contracts as a live request.

tools.name: analyze_usgs_seismicity_b_value
tools.description: Estimate magnitude of completeness (maximum curvature with correction, goodness-of-fit 90/95%, b-value stability), the Aki maximum-likelihood b-value with Shi & Bolt uncertainty and Utsu binning correction, the a-value, annual rates and return periods with a b-uncertainty band, and a sliding-window b-value series from one complete, provenance-hashed USGS catalog.

tools.name: analyze_usgs_aftershock_productivity
tools.description: Extend a bounded Omori–Utsu fit with Båth's law (observed and modified), the aftershock b-value, sequence duration to a declared background rate, and a caveated forecast table of expected aftershocks ≥ M over N days with Poisson counting intervals.

tools.name: analyze_tidal_harmonics
tools.description: Least-squares tidal harmonic analysis over a bounded constituent catalogue (M2, S2, N2, K2, K1, O1, P1, Q1, M4, MS4, Sa, Ssa) with Rayleigh-criterion selection, amplitude and phase standard errors, residuals, form factor, a predicted high/low water table, and an observed-versus-predicted figure.

tools.name: analyze_climate_trend
tools.description: Sea-level or climate series trend: OLS linear trend with seasonal harmonics and AR(1)-corrected uncertainty (Santer et al. 2000), Mann–Kendall with the Hamed–Rao autocorrelation correction, Sen's slope with a Gilbert confidence interval, and the Pettitt change point.

tools.name: analyze_drought_index
tools.description: Standardized Precipitation Index at 1/3/6/12-month (or declared) scales with the Thom gamma fit and mixed zero distribution, or SPEI with the L-moment log-logistic fit when potential evapotranspiration is supplied; returns monthly index values, McKee drought categories, event tables, and per-month fit parameters.

tools.name: analyze_flood_frequency
tools.description: Annual-peak flood frequency analysis: Log-Pearson III by Bulletin 17B method of moments with optional regional-skew weighting and Appendix 9 confidence limits, Gumbel method of moments with Kite standard errors, and GEV by L-moments; returns a return-period table and a frequency-curve figure with plotting positions.

tools.name: analyze_isochron
tools.description: York (2004) errors-in-variables isochron regression with correlated x/y errors, MSWD and probability of fit, initial ratio, and the isochron age from a tabulated decay-constant catalogue (Rb–Sr, Sm–Nd, Lu–Hf, Re–Os, U–Pb 238/235, or custom λ).

tools.name: classify_tas
tools.description: Classify volcanic rock analyses on the total alkali–silica diagram (Le Bas et al. 1986) with optional anhydrous recalculation, report the field vertex catalogue used, and return AFM ternary fractions and coordinates.

tools.name: analyze_spatial_autocorrelation
tools.description: Global Moran's I and Geary's C with inverse-distance or k-nearest-neighbour weights and randomisation z-scores, plus a local Moran (LISA) table with quadrant clusters and analytical conditional-randomisation moments.

tools.name: describe_earth_science_capabilities
tools.description: Return the exact implemented source, output, renderer, and unsupported-feature boundaries for this plugin.
